claim: Arowana, September 2021: Lucky Bay 'generates road freight savings for grain growers from the Eyre Peninsula of up to $15 per tonne'.

R1_vs_nearest_bunge_upcountry.description: Grower switches from the nearest Bunge upcountry silo to Lucky Bay. Saving = cartage(nearest Bunge upcountry) - cartage(Lucky Bay). This is the negative of R9's primary measure M2, restricted to upcountry silos.

R1b_vs_nearest_bunge_any.description: Grower switches from the nearest Bunge receival point of any role (silo or port) to Lucky Bay. Exactly the negative of R9's M2 at state A.

R2_vs_port_lincoln.description: Grower who would otherwise cart farm-direct to Port Lincoln instead carts farm-direct to Lucky Bay.

R3_vs_thevenard.description: Grower who would otherwise cart farm-direct to Thevenard instead carts farm-direct to Lucky Bay.

R4_vs_nearest_bunge_port.description: Grower who carts farm-direct to an export port: nearest Bunge port (Port Lincoln or Thevenard) vs Lucky Bay. This is R9's M4, C -> A.

R5_stateB_vs_nearest_bunge_any.description: SEPTEMBER-2021 NETWORK (state B: Lucky Bay + Lock + Kimba bunkers). Grower switches from the nearest Bunge point to the nearest T-Ports point. Negative of R9's M2 at state B. This is the state that actually existed on the date of the claim.

R6_whole_road_chain_to_port.description: WHOLE ROAD FREIGHT TASK, not the grower's leg alone. Without Lucky Bay: farm -> nearest Bunge point (grower, road) PLUS that site -> Port Lincoln or Thevenard (operator, road; EP grain rail ceased May 2019). With Lucky Bay: farm -> Lucky Bay (grower, road) and nothing further, because the grain is already at an export position. This is the most claimant-favourable arithmetic on this page and it is NOT a grower saving - most of the removed distance is the operator's.

R7_operator_linehaul_only.description: The operator's upcountry-silo -> port line haul alone, which Lucky Bay removes for any load tipped at the port. Not a grower saving under any reading of the words 'for grain growers' unless it is passed through, which this project cannot observe.
